title: Quiz generation with Gemini structured output: validate, retry, back off
scenario: Kestrel's /quiz/generate prototype calls Gemini once in text mode and trusts the JSON. The pilot got 3-option items, answerIndex 4, citations to sections that do not exist, stems that gave the answer away, and a 500 storm when PayGo capacity was tight at 09:00. Make it production-grade in Java 21 against a scripted Gemini fake.
task: Response schema in Gemini's OpenAPI-subset style and JSON mode on the request
A validator for meaning: counts, ranges, distinct options, grounding, giveaways
Corrective retries with the problems fed back, capped at 3
SAFETY and RECITATION as Blocked; full-jitter backoff with Retry-After and a deadline
Tokens and cost summed across attempts
acceptance: Hidden JUnit tests for request, schema, each validation rule and retry path
Exact backoff sleeps and no sleep past the deadline
ANSWER.md: why validate under a schema, Blocked vs Failed, retry cost
